name: tqx-uat-plugin
description: Let TQX help you invest and trade

interface.shortDescription: Invest and trade with TQX UAT
interface.longDescription: Connect your TQX UAT account to view balances, positions, orders, trades, and cash flows, and execute trading instructions. Research Hong Kong and US factors and strategies through Qube analyses, backtests, versions and parameter tuning. Trading and research use client-managed OAuth with separate scopes; research does not require a trading Agent binding. Local market data uses the included Python skill and requires a TQX API key and compatible Python environment.
defaultPrompt: Show my TQX account balance and positions.
List my active orders and recent trades.
Help me set up Hong Kong and US market data.
Create and backtest a US stock momentum strategy.
